datadis_auth_failed.title: Datadis rejected the stored credentials
datadis_auth_failed.description:
Datadis does not accept the saved username/password (or authorized NIF). Hourly consumption will not update.

Go to Settings → Devices & Services → Enchufado, press the gear icon (**Configure**) and re-enter your datadis.es credentials (no need to delete the integration).

datadis_quota_exhausted.title: Datadis daily quota exhausted
datadis_quota_exhausted.description: The Datadis API is returning its daily request limit. Enchufado will not make further requests until next midnight (peninsular Spain) to avoid aggravating the quota.

datadis_unreachable.title: Datadis is unreachable
datadis_unreachable.description: Requests to the Datadis API are failing (network or server error). Enchufado will retry on the next import cycle; no action needed.

esios_token_rejected.title: ESIOS-REE rejected the API token
esios_token_rejected.description:
The ESIOS-REE API returns an authentication error for the configured token. PVPC prices will not update.

Request a new token from ESIOS by email and enter it under Settings → Devices & Services → Enchufado → ⚙️ **Configure**.

esios_token_missing.title: ESIOS-REE API token missing
esios_token_missing.description:
The integration has no ESIOS-REE API token, so PVPC prices and cost statistics are not generated.

Request a free personal token from ESIOS by email and enter it under Settings → Devices & Services → Enchufado → ⚙️ **Configure**.

esios_unreachable.title: ESIOS-REE is unreachable
esios_unreachable.description: PVPC price requests to the ESIOS-REE API are failing. Enchufado will retry on the next cycle; consumption import continues normally.
